correctness.rationale: The Stern pair recursion gives an exact 48-state finite automaton. All state-row polynomial annihilators were checked using exhaustive integer computations from the packaged verifier; initialization yields all eight rational series, including the shorter residue-four series by a nine-term uniqueness argument. Uniform stationary measure follows from the transitive aperiodic permutation walks. Reciprocal denominator factors lie at modulus at most sqrt(2); reduced fractions force nonzero square-root spectral modes for each residue, and Cesaro orthogonality gives individually positive normalized limsup. Direct enumeration through depth 17 independently confirms finite instances but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete exact distribution over all residue classes modulo eight is a natural finite-modulus arithmetic census. The eight rational generating functions and sharp individual square-root discrepancy order give all-depth exact evaluations and new classwise quantitative structure beyond published stationary densities and a prior single difference statistic; no artificial parameter restriction or merely routine substitution is introduced.
